about: Sung still for S8a (user on c5: 「我觉得这是还是要动嘴,这样你可以就做图,然后拼起来变成动态图」). motion-kit/tools/region_plates.py pastes each variant's mouth (m) or eyes (e) into K7 through the feathered shapes below (K7 plate px; paths relative to ep01/v2) and writes plates/K7m<shape>.png and plates/K7e<eye>.png; motion-kit/src/mouth.js steps through them on the measured sung words (timing/words.json): each word is a list of [shape, fraction of the word], shapes lead the sound by lead_frames, a pause of rest_gap_s closes the mouth. Shapes: X rest (K7, lips closed), B lips just apart on a consonant, C half open, D open vowel, F rounded. Eyes: one blink (H half, C closed) in the breath after 'run'.
